name: Hunter M. Barrow
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas

about: Hunter Barrow has a broad litigation practice in trial and appellate courts. He has experience handling a wide variety of matters, involving securities, financial institutions, energy, real estate, intellectual property, antitrust, insurance, product liability, and general commercial litigation. Hunter’s clients span numerous industries, including energy, banking and finance, real estate development, private equity, and manufacturing.

Hunter is Board Certified in Civil Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. He is also a Board Certified Civil Trial Advocate by the National Board of Trial Advocacy and a Board Certified Civil Pretrial Practice Advocate by the National Board of Civil Pretrial Practice Advocacy.
